agent_discovery.description: Inspect the latest Fabric-hosted semantic sphere scene produced for the integrated arm controller. Reports freshness, ROI policies, obstacle/work-object/pushable counts, producer identity, depth fallback mode, fresh arm-base-aligned WORK_OBJECT visible-surface AABBs with named corners, a missing camera-to-arm-base transform prerequisite, and optionally a bounded list of spheres. This Skill never starts hardware and never authorizes motion.
when_to_use: The operator asks whether semantic sphere marking is running or ready to test.
An agent needs to verify that the integrated controller has a fresh environment scene.
A test needs the current hand-angular or legacy ROI policies, sphere classes, or depth fallback state.
An agent needs a fresh right/left, forward/backward, or up/down corner of a visible work object in the arm-base frame.
when_not_to_use: A new point cloud or semantic classification must be produced; publish an upstream Fabric observation or activate the scene compiler Provider.
Physical movement is requested; this inspection does not plan or authorize motion.

include_spheres.description: Include a bounded raw sphere list in addition to the summary.

maximum_spheres.description: Maximum raw spheres returned when include_spheres is true.
